probe.hash_collision_assumption: negligible relative to analytic path collision

analysis.primary_metric: geometric expected leading-risk ratio bound to the strong fixed-q baseline after all probe messages
analysis.active_cell: cellwise asymptotic oracle q differs from the overhead-specific strong fixed q
analysis.inactive_cell: cellwise asymptotic oracle q equals the overhead-specific strong fixed q

mandatory_gates.S1: public kernel, stationarity, and marginal-invariance checks pass
mandatory_gates.S2: every minimal fingerprint has exact independent-path collision <= 0.01
mandatory_gates.S3: every delayed recursion is stable and the post-probe q=16 learning horizon meets the 1e-4 contraction rule
mandatory_gates.S5: geometric expected full-cost improvement >= 0.05 for each message overhead
mandatory_gates.S6: expected ratio bound < 1 in at least 0.70 of oracle-active cells
mandatory_gates.S7: maximum expected ratio bound over every cell <= 1.05
mandatory_gates.S8: plug-in participation is nonincreasing on the registered rho grid
mandatory_gates.S9: probe messages, probe environment transitions, learning messages, learning transitions, and delay satisfy separate budgets
mandatory_gates.S10: no sampled trajectory, seed, GPU, HPC4 job, or T-049A outcome row is used
